compatibilityNotes: Pair with the Kickstart version used by the original hardware. Mismatched Kickstart/extended ROM pairs may fail CD boot.
contentsDescription: Contains CD32/CDTV-specific boot code, ISO9660 filesystem support, audio drivers, and often additional icon/tool resources. Works in tandem with a compatible Kickstart ROM.
history: Commodore shipped CDTV in 1991 as a living-room Amiga, followed by the A570 expansion and the CD32 console in 1993. Each platform needed extra firmware beyond Kickstart to manage the CD subsystem.
purpose: Enables CD-based boot, audio CD playback, and console-style startup on CDTV/CD32, or CD-ROM expansion on A500-class machines.
summary: Extended ROM firmware for Commodore CDTV. Adds CD filesystem support, audio/CD streaming helpers, and boot logic beyond standard Kickstart.
technicalInsights: Extended ROM is mapped separately from Kickstart; emulators need both ROM sets configured.
Revision numbers often track paired Kickstart releases (e.g. r40.60 for late CD32).
Some dumps are socket-specific (U34/U35) reflecting physical ROM placement on the board.
title: CDTV Extended-ROM v1.0
